payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and metrics used to measure topic quality, particularly through the use of meta information and coherence scores like NPMI.

claims.text: Topic quality is measured using Normalized Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) scores, which assess topic coherence based on word co-occurrence.
Incorporating document and word meta information into topic models improves topic quality by enhancing modeling accuracy and coherence.
MetaLDA, a topic model, demonstrates improved topic quality through the integration of meta information, as evidenced by experimental results.
